title: Top-down PLM assembly with single-relation temporal-memory isolation
question: Can an explicitly sequential persistent multi-timescale state solve a fixed history-dependent temporal decision when hidden relation-family variation is removed?
hypothesis: If the persistent state mechanism is sufficient for this temporal decision, the MTSK state arm should outperform no-state, and the three-timescale state should outperform the single-timescale state by the registered materiality margin on unseen histories.

endpoints.name: exact_class_balanced_success
endpoints.description: Exact held-out verified action success on 200 fresh evaluation examples (100 exact-negation pairs) at each H/seed; primary decision at H=256.

endpoints.name: history_conditioned_action_gap
endpoints.description: Fraction of exact-negation pairs for which the model chooses opposite actions with identical current observation.

endpoints.name: state_intervention_effect
endpoints.description: Frozen MTSK checkpoint success after terminal-state reset or cross-episode state shuffle.

endpoints.name: representation_sign_accuracy
endpoints.description: Independent analytical sign agreement on a separate benchmark seed stream.

endpoints.name: evaluation_work
endpoints.description: Explicit sequential state-update, policy, executor and verifier work under the common accounting.

decision_rule.condition: At H=256, MTSK exceeds single_timescale by more than 0.10 and the seed-bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero, while MTSK also exceeds no_state.
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that multiple persistent temporal scales improve the isolated fixed-relation temporal-memory task.
decision_rule.does_not_license: multi-family relation inference, general intelligence, biological equivalence, multimodal competence, asymptotic scaling, or hardware speedup.

decision_rule.condition: All stateful arms materially outperform no_state but MTSK does not materially exceed single_timescale.
decision_rule.licenses: the isolated task establishes persistent-state usefulness but not a multi-timescale advantage.
the registered memory-isolation hypothesis is not established.

held_constant: ground-truth temporal contrast is exactly alpha=0.45 versus alpha=0.985
no pair-type or relation-family identifier is present because the relation family is fixed by the benchmark
train and test seed streams use disjoint deterministic namespaces
test histories are generated only by the dedicated test stream and are not reused from prior MTSK lanes
each test history is paired with its exact negation and opposite label
policy architecture, optimizer, learning rate, hidden width and parameter count are identical across arms
the state recurrence executes sequentially observation-by-observation before the terminal decision
evaluation length is exactly 200 examples = 100 exact-negation pairs per H/seed/arm
the independent representability witness uses a separate seed stream and never supplies training or test data

amendments.old_definition: The preregistered evaluator reported eval_steps=200 but the runner generated a hard-coded 100 test pairs, and the implementation computed terminal exponential filters directly.
amendments.new_definition: eval_steps=200 is enforced and used to generate exactly 100 test pairs; state features are produced by an explicit PersistentTemporalState.update() recurrence over the history.
amendments.rationale: The original implementation left a registered dimension only nominally enforced and obscured whether the intended intervention was an actual sequential state mechanism. No confirmatory scientific result was measured under the pre-amendment implementation.
amendments.discovered: CI source audit before confirmatory measurement

amendments.old_definition: The contract carried k_levels=[1,2,3] even though the experiment had no K/delay factor.
amendments.new_definition: The irrelevant k_levels field is removed; the lane is governed only by its registered H, seed, step, evaluation and arm dimensions.
amendments.rationale: An unused registered dimension creates false assurance and invites accidental protocol drift.
amendments.discovered: CI source audit before confirmatory measurement
